note: TWENTY ONE TV news segment (App\Support\Caster\NewsScripts): an intro line per section, the headline read word for word with its source, then the commentary. The league voice writes the commentary; these reactions stand in when it is off or its draft fails a check. They are opinion only: no facts, no names, no numbers, and they must fit any headline of their section. Markus Turm's voice: Bitcoin-libertarian, critical of the state and of socialism, Allgäu-casual, sarcastic but never against a private person or a group.
